description.subtitle: Nike Total 90 Football Neck Gaiter - Black
description.tagline: Lightweight protection with a retro spirit
description.intro: The Nike Total 90 Dri-FIT neck warmer keeps your neck warm without losing breathability. Ideal for cold training days, with a fitted design and 100% football aesthetic.
key_benefits: Keeps you dry: Dri-FIT technology that eliminates sweat.
Perfect fit: Ergonomic design with optional nose cover.
T90 style: Details that pay tribute to a golden era.
Light and functional: Ideal for training without distractions.

source.subtitle: Braga de cuello para fútbol Nike Total 90 - negra
source.intro: La braga Nike Total 90 Dri-FIT mantiene el cuello caliente sin perder transpirabilidad. Ideal para los días fríos de entreno, con diseño ajustado y estética 100% futbolera.
key_benefits: Te mantiene seco: Tecnología Dri-FIT que elimina el sudor.
Ajuste perfecto: Diseño ergonómico con cubrenariz opcional.
Estilo T90: Detalles que rinden tributo a una era dorada.
Ligera y funcional: Ideal para entrenar sin distracciones.
